text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—And into the home stretch!! The home 
stretch of the Japanese Derby!! Up the 
hill they charge! Which Umamusume will 
seize victory!?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —WOOOOAAHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Haahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(————Ah, I feel it, Kris S...! The 
heartbeat of you treading upon the earth!! 
It resonates all the way to my very 
heart!!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(I am certain of it...! The chains of my 
destiny share their weight with none other 
than you...!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(Then let us run!! Burning through 
everything... together!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Across the line!! Claiming the Japan Derby 
crown is—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh... So close, Gimlet...! Still, you 
were seriously amazing!! Delivering real 
results on the Mile Championship rotation!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You were so cool...! You may have lost, 
but you shone brighter than anyone 
else...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Good grief, what a fickle thing fate is.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ......Gimlet――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Even so, we both poured out every ounce of 
our soul's surge. Is this, too, a turning 
point for us—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Gimlet!! So close! Great job completing 
the Mile Championship rotation!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You were amaziiing!! I'll never forget 
that runnn!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh... Hahahaha...—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Bwaaaaa-hahahaha!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Witnesses! Go wild and rave with passion!! 
Let Tanino Gimlet be seared into your 
eyes!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
(Gimlet!! Lady Gimlet!! That was so 
close!! You're the strongest!!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Senpai... You must be more frustrated than 
anyone else, and yet... You stand so tall 
and proud...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Incredible...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, you're so cool... 
Gim-senpai...!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...That was—the fervor brought about by 
you—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...That's my line, Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Your stern, unyielding run that sought to 
crush the chains of fate... was truly 
beautiful—

"Though she narrowly missed out on 
victory, she fully proved her 'strength.' 
As I went to greet Tanino Gimlet—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—It didn't quite turn out to be the 
supreme cup, did it?
choice_data_list:
Still, you drove me, the crowd, everyone 
wild!

Still, you drove me, the crowd, everyone 
wild!

text_block_list.text:
I raised an invisible glass to Tanino 
Gimlet, one brimming with undeniable 
warmth.
choice_data_list: Cheers to your speed and your strength.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ――Gim-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Vodka——

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Um!! Thank you so much... for your hard 
work in the Derby!!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I was so moved...! And that's why, 
I...!!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Tch...... Dammit! The words won't......! 
But, Senpai!! I really――――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Did I look cool?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Did I look cooler in your eyes... than 
anyone or anything else?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Gim-senpai is... the coolest in the 
world... She'll always, always be the 
senpai I look up to!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —I see.

After parting ways with Vodka, who shared 
her heartfelt thanks, I returned to the 
waiting room to find—

Something about Tanino Gimlet's posture 
strikes me as terribly off. At first 
glance, she looks just as she always does, 
but—
choice_data_list: ...Is anything feeling off with your body?
...Does anything feel off with your body?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh—no problem at all. I may be exhausted 
from that mortal duel, but my soul is 
burning even brighter and hotter than it 
did back at the NHK Mile Cup...!

Even watching her speak with such 
certainty, I couldn't shake my sense of 
unease. Perhaps she herself hadn't 
realized that something was wrong—
choice_data_list:
Let's get a detailed checkup right after 
this.

text_block_list.text:
I wanted to check immediately whether this 
sense of unease was real. If it was 
nothing, we could just laugh it off.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...You sensed something, didn't you? Then 
let us follow your intuition――

And after a detailed examination... it was 
discovered that an abnormality was 
developing in Tanino Gimlet's left leg.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"—It was fortunate we caught it early this 
time. Had we been even a little later, 
returning to racing would have become 
entirely out of the question."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Even so, the current situation doesn't 
allow for optimism. You need to refrain 
from racing and rest until around the end 
of June.
choice_data_list: Will Gimlet be able to race again...?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
A possibility still remains. ...However, 
it will be an extremely harsh challenge.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"If we are to work toward returning to 
racing, you must be prepared for the risk 
that the symptoms might worsen beyond what 
they are now."

"...The day after the 'Japanese Derby'. A 
whirlwind of frustration and helplessness 
raged inside me."

For the sake of Tanino Gimlet and everyone 
cheering for her, we will see the Mile 
Championship rotation through to a safe 
conclusion.

I swore that to myself and did everything 
I could. And yet, I couldn't prevent 
Tanino Gimlet from getting injured...—
If only I hadn't been so powerless...

—However, I can't just stand still. What I 
need to do right now is get Tanino Gimlet 
back on the track!

I desperately shake off the frustration 
and sense of powerlessness. I need to 
reorganize the plan for Tanino Gimlet's 
comeback...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Working hard, I see.
Around that time, she suddenly appeared.

Seeing not a trace of gloom in her 
expression, I feel relieved. I decide to 
consult with her right away about our 
plans moving forward—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...If it's to discuss future plans, there 
is no need.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...It truly was beautiful. The sight after 
finishing the Japan Derby... The sheer 
frenzy that took over that place.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
As if gazing down upon the end from a 
resplendent hall... It was catastrophic, 
and yet, eternal.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"And I...—I was able to etch my own 
running into them and find a new chaos 
that strives toward an even more brilliant 
future."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“—All of this belongs to you, who fought 
alongside me.”

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Be proud. And—what comes "next" is your 
turn.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —I've had enough.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
With this, my play comes to an end. I 
shall step down from the stage of 
glittering stars... and take my seat in 
the shadows.

...Tanino Gimlet is now about to step away 
from racing. She is on the verge of 
locking away that potential by her own 
hand.

"I didn't want that. Absolutely not. So I 
tried to stop it... I tried to speak the 
words to bring it to a halt."
However————

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. I shall remain unwavering, 
betting everything on the MC rotation and 
my own aesthetic."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"If I dwell on what comes 'after', these 
legs will hesitate, and I will lose my 
'speed.'"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"'...The MC rotation is not something that 
can be achieved with such half-baked 
"strength".'"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Therefore, I will forge ahead. Without 
hesitation, with an iron will stronger 
than anyone's."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"If you decide to work toward returning to 
racing, you must be prepared for the risk 
that the condition may worsen."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: “――――I've had enough.”

The days I had spent with Tanino Gimlet. 
The risks lurking in the future I was 
about to choose. Her deeply satisfied 
expression. Everything blurred into chaos.

The words that were on the tip of my 
tongue vanished.

And so... just how much time had passed, 
one wonders—
choice_data_list:
........................You really saw it 
through, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

Tanino Gimlet made her dream come true. If 
she can say that with certainty... then 
what lies ahead is entirely her own 
domain.

As Tanino Gimlet's Trainer, nothing could 
make me prouder――――――than this.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...For now, I can only offer my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer.

—Honestly, anything after that is just a 
blur now.

Tanino Gimlet's announcement to retire 
from racing spread through the world in an 
instant—
To many, it brought shock, confusion, and—
It left a deep, indelible scar...—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"—Tanino Gimlet's sudden declaration seems 
to have left the fans utterly bewildered, 
and opinions are flying in every 
direction."

text_block_list.name: Gimlet Fan A
text_block_list.text:
“—Well, since it's an injury... I'd say it 
was a wise decision.”

text_block_list.name: Gimlet Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Because I'm sure it's with Gimlet's 
future in mind. Besides, Gimlet has 
already achieved more than enough 
wonderful results."

text_block_list.name: Gimlet Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"I'm devastated... I wanted to see her 
race so much more..."

text_block_list.name: Gimlet Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"『I can't help thinking it happened 
because she took on the MC Rotation... but 
taking on challenges like that is what 
makes Gimlet who she is... so it's 
complicated.』"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
“—Everyone's saying all sorts of things, 
but I really think the Trainer bears 
significant responsibility for not 
stopping her after the Satsuki Sho.”

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Gimlet basically had to run an entire 
extra race worth of effort going into the 
Derby. The fatigue must be on a completely 
different level."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
""How responsibility will be handled in 
this regard is something we'll want to 
keep an eye on going forward—""

...Day after day, the media covered Tanino 
Gimlet's declaration, and voices began 
questioning my responsibility for her 
injury.

The fault of failing to prevent Tanino 
Gimlet's injury lies squarely on me. ...I 
must take appropriate action.
Yet, even before that……—

"...The look Tanino Gimlet showed me back 
then. The words Tanino Gimlet gave me."

"That brought about a sense of calm... 
inside my heart."
choice_data_list: If Gimlet isn't going to race anymore—

text_block_list.text:
The sky outside the window was a 
refreshing, crisp blue.
